# RaceProof anonymized-evidence consent

Before sending this request, replace the fenced block with the exact proposed
record generated for `beta/evidence.json`. It must contain no identity, contact,
repository, raw-log, production-data, or free-text field.

```json
PASTE THE EXACT PROPOSED ANONYMIZED RECORD HERE
```

Please answer **yes** or **no**:

> I have reviewed the exact record above and consent to its publication in the
> public RaceProof repository and generated beta report. I understand that Git
> history may retain prior versions. I can request removal from future versions
> by contacting the maintainer through our existing private channel.

No response is treated as no consent. Participation in the beta does not imply consent.
Record the date privately; only set `anonymized_publication` to `true` after an
affirmative response.
